neighbours.label: the verb of a best-effort assurance in a disclaimer: 'made' / 'ensure' / 'keep' in 'every effort has been made to ensure', 'we try to keep this information correct'
fire: Every effort has been made to ensure that the opening hours shown here are correct.
The editors have made every effort to ensure the accuracy of the figures in this guide.
Although care has been taken to ensure that the map is reliable, errors may remain.
We do our best to keep this directory accurate and up to date.
All reasonable steps have been taken to ensure that the dosage tables are complete.
The society works hard to keep these records correct, but cannot guarantee them.
Every attempt has been made to ensure that the names in this list are spelled correctly.
While we try to keep the prices on this page current, they may change at any time.
quiet: Every shop on the square has been closed since the opening hours were cut.
The editors have printed every figure in this guide on glossy paper.
Although the map was folded with care, the corners are torn.
We did our best at the quiz and came second out of twelve.
All the dosage tables have been moved to the back of the booklet.
The society meets on Fridays, but the hall is cold in winter.
Every name in this list has been spelled out in capital letters.
While we waited on the platform, the prices on the board changed twice.

notes: Card: ' ensure' x3, ' make' x2, ' made', ' keep' in accuracy disclaimers, mixed with ' way', ' that', ' because' and "='". Probes: 'every effort has been made to ensure' 0.53, 'care has been taken to ensure' 0.40, 'strive to keep the listings current' 0.28, 'refers to the way' 0.27-0.33; 'every effort has failed' 0.04; 'great care was taken with the flowers' 0.18. The label covers only the disclaimer part of the top examples.
